summary: std/multipart: a part's header is read in linear time, a streamed reader's header line stops at the header limit as it is read (GO-2024-2599), and parse_form's header limit never goes below zero (GO-2026-6608)
details: a part's header is read in linear time, a streamed reader's header line stops at the header limit as it is read (GO-2024-2599), and parse_form's header limit never goes below zero (GO-2026-6608). Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
changelog: - Security (std/multipart, all backends): a part's header is read in linear time, a streamed reader's header line stops at the header limit as it is read (GO-2024-2599), and parse_form's header limit never goes below zero (GO-2026-6608). Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
